Don’t trust everything you see on YouTube… 😭

CODA (2021) tells a touching coming-of-age story centered on Ruby, the only hearing person in a deaf household. The film’s title refers to “Child of Deaf Adults.” Ruby plays a vital role in her family’s life, helping run their struggling fishing business and serving as their interpreter in interactions with the outside world.

While balancing these responsibilities, she unexpectedly discovers a love for singing after joining her school choir. As her abilities develop, Ruby is torn between her commitment to her family and the opportunity to pursue her passion at a music school.

The film thoughtfully explores themes of identity, family bonds, and communication, while offering meaningful insight into deaf culture. It was widely acclaimed and went on to win several Academy Awards.

source_details.synopsis: CODA is a 2021 coming-of-age comedy-drama film written and directed by Sian Heder. An English-language remake of the 2014 French-Belgian film La Famille Bélier, it stars Emilia Jones as Ruby Rossi, the child of deaf adults (CODA) and only hearing member of her family, who attempts to help her family's struggling fishing business while pursuing her aspirations to become a singer. The movie uses deaf actors to play the deaf characters, who, along with Jones, communicate using American Sign Language.
